name: 41 Syrian
description: 41 Syrian also known as 400 or Arba3meyeh. Four-player partnership trick-taking. 52 cards, Hearts permanent trump. 13 cards each, counter-clockwise. Bid tricks minimum 1; total bids at least 11 or redeal. Bids 1-6 score face value, 7+ double. Fail is negative. Win when one partner reaches 41 and the other positive.

content.text: 41 Syrian also known as 400 or Arba3meyeh. Four-player partnership trick-taking. 52 cards, Hearts permanent trump. 13 cards each, counter-clockwise. Bid tricks minimum 1; total bids at least 11 or redeal. Bids 1-6 score face value, 7+ double. Fail is negative. Win when one partner reaches 41 and the other positive.

This trick-taking game is often known as 400 (arba3meyeh). It is much played in Syria and to some extent in Lebanon; the name 400 does not arise in the scoring. The rules were documented from multiple contributors in the early 2000s.
Four players in two fixed partnerships; partners sit as in Bridge (North-South versus East-West).
Standard 52-card pack, ranking A-K-Q-J-10 down to 2; Hearts is the permanent trump suit.
13 cards each, dealt anticlockwise in batches of 1-2-2-2-2-2-2; dealer rotates anticlockwise.

items.text: Lebanese 400 scoring variation: Lebanese 400 follows the same core structure as 41 but uses a different minimum bid, higher mandatory minimum bids at certain score bands, and a non-linear trick-bid to points table.
